Market today: The tech and chip sector continues to see tailwinds from AI demand, with Nvidia-related news driving positive sentiment. However, broader market concerns like rising Euro zone inflation and potential interest rate hikes could create headwinds for growth stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -55.68% and marked SELL; as a leveraged ETF, this drawdown is amplified by margin and decay. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is new but already down -36.82%. SMH (-12.53%) and QQQI (-3.21%) are also marked TRIM and need attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on Apple's transition and AI strategy, as well as the ongoing strength of chip demand. Also, monitor global inflation trends and their potential impact on interest rates, which can affect your tech-heavy portfolio.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and respecting stops to protect capital, especially with margin amplifying losses.
plays: SOXL is down -55.68% and marked SELL. Consider trimming this leveraged position to reduce margin exposure and mitigate further decay.
SPAL is a new, leveraged position already down -36.82%. Respect its stop at 21.38 to limit further losses.
SMH is marked TRIM and down -12.53%. Consider reducing exposure or tighten your stop around 540.
